rows.grounds: locative of tat-kāla, referring to the previously specified moment
vocative address to a feminine figure characterized by restless glances
feminine form indicating identity with the nature of supreme brahman

items.question: What essential nature belongs to the tremulous-eyed one at that specific time?
premises: The reference is to that specific time.
The tremulous-eyed one is directly addressed.
She is characterized as having the nature of supreme brahman.
items.inference: At that specific time, the tremulous-eyed one is of the nature of supreme brahman.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tatkāle depends on the preceding ritual or cosmic context.
items.plain_english: At that time, O tremulous-eyed one, you are of the nature of the supreme Brahman.
